summary: Add inactive raw cgroup usage parsers and host-stamped file reads (unit 12b)

rules.detail: No host activation; gate-slot remains the admission path.

compatibility.detail: Additive raw cpu.stat usage_usec and memory.peak parsing, plus preserved memory.events and io.stat counters. Each file read carries the caller-supplied host name and its own host timestamp, including unknown reads. Missing or malformed numeric counters are Unknown, never zero. Empty successfully read io.stat remains measured. CPU counters require start/end samples for deltas; no interval totals are inferred.
